name: Erkel AI
author: reluai

sections.description:
Erkel AI adds the Erkel assistant to your public WordPress pages without editing theme files. If you are new to Erkel, create and verify an Erkel account, add your website to your workspace, then return to Settings → Erkel AI to connect it. Choose the matching website and approve the exact WordPress domain. The plugin stores only the public site ID; it does not request or share your WordPress password, Erkel password, or an Erkel API key.

The connection adds the approved HTTPS website origin to the selected Erkel website. It does not publish or enable an assistant that is off in your Erkel workspace, start a trial, or purchase a plan. The assistant continues to use Erkel’s existing widget and workspace settings. An active plan or an Erkel-approved trial is required before the owner can publish the visitor widget.

Privacy

The plugin stores the public Erkel site ID in the WordPress site’s options. It adds Erkel’s embed script to public pages. The widget requests appearance settings from Erkel when a page loads, and makes further requests when visitors open or use the assistant. The plugin itself does not send WordPress account details to Erkel. See Erkel’s Privacy Policy for information about the widget’s normal requests.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Erkel hosted service at https://erkel.ai. The connection is made only after a WordPress administrator starts the connection and approves the exact website domain in Erkel. Erkel receives that website domain and a temporary, single-use authorization code during setup. WordPress stores the selected public Erkel site ID.

When connected, the plugin loads Erkel’s public widget script on the website. The script requests widget appearance settings when a page loads. If a visitor opens or uses the assistant, the browser sends the visitor’s question and conversation data needed to provide the service to Erkel. See Erkel’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Service for details.

Support

For help with Erkel, visit Erkel Support.
sections.installation:
1. After WordPress.org lists the plugin, install it from Plugins > Add New Plugin. For a private pilot, use Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin and choose the Erkel AI ZIP.
  2. Open Settings > Erkel AI and select Connect Erkel. If you are new to Erkel, create an account and verify your email first.
  3. In Erkel, add your business website if it is not already in your workspace. Return to this WordPress tab and select Check again.
  4. Choose the matching Erkel website, review the exact WordPress domain, and approve the connection.
  5. Connecting does not start a trial, buy a plan, or turn on the visitor assistant. An active plan or an Erkel-approved trial is required to publish. The owner enables the assistant from Erkel when ready.
  6. Open the published site in a private browser window and confirm the Erkel face appears. If it does not, check that the assistant is enabled and that the exact HTTPS origin is allowed in Erkel.
  7. If you previously added Erkel’s snippet manually, remove the old copy after confirming the plugin works.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin change my theme?

No. It loads Erkel’s widget through WordPress’s script-loading system. No theme file edits are needed.

What information is shared to connect?

The Erkel connection sends the exact WordPress HTTPS origin and a temporary, single-use authorization code. WordPress exchanges that code server-to-server and stores only the public site ID. Passwords and private API keys are never shared.

The widget does not appear. What should I check?

Confirm that the Erkel site ID was saved, the exact HTTPS website origin is allowed in Erkel, and the widget is enabled. Clear your WordPress or hosting cache, then check the published site in a private browser window. Some older or custom themes may not load WordPress’s standard footer scripts.

How do I remove the widget?

Use Disconnect this WordPress website in Settings > Erkel AI, or clear the saved site ID in the manual setup field. This removes the ID from WordPress so the widget stops loading here. To revoke the website origin in Erkel too, remove that origin in your Erkel website settings. Your Erkel workspace and knowledge remain in Erkel.
sections.changelog:
0.3.0

  • Allow owners to disconnect and clear the saved site ID.
  • Add a direct disconnect action protected by WordPress capability and nonce checks.

0.2.0

  • Add secure Connect Erkel flow with owner approval and domain registration.
  • Keep manual snippet entry as an optional fallback.
